text: alex: Quick heads up — uploaded the revised launch blog draft + demo video schedule. Need a short final pass on tone, CTA, and webinar timing. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch-blog/1871234999-draft (comments inline welcome). maya: reading now. ask — can we make the primary CTA 'Register for webinar' instead of 'Request demo'? higher conversion and grows the list. sam: +1 on webinar CTA. Also ensure inbound leads from the blog go straight into the 'Launch Product' pipeline in HubSpot, not the generic MQL queue. olivia: tagging legal for the demo script — @lisa any issues with the privacy callout? we mention customer data flows briefly. lisa: skimmed the script. add: 'We do not retain personal data from demo sessions beyond troubleshooting and analytics; see our privacy policy for details.' I'll add exact link. patrick: growth ask — use UTM template so we can segment traffic. propose: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_content=webinar_cta. Can someone add to the CTA hrefs? alex: will add. deciding between H2 CTA text options: 'Watch demo' vs 'Register for webinar' — thoughts? maya: 'Register for webinar' — clearer call to action. sam: confirmed. set form to only ask name, work email, company (no phone) to reduce friction. olivia: calendar-bot scheduled: calendar-bot: Event created by olivia — 'Launch blog final review' Wed Mar 13 10:00-10:30 PT — Guests: alex, maya, sam, olivia, lisa lisa: legal ok on privacy line, add link to /legal/privacy. patrick: growth flagged hidden field required: 'source=blog_post' so HubSpot can tag leads automatically. We'll add that to the form embed. alex: dev snippet for CTA button: Register for webinar maya: visuals note — hero should be 1200x600 and align with the demo screenshot. uploaded 3 options to the draft folder, pick one by EOD. sam: confirming HubSpot flow: form -> Lifecycle Stage: Lead -> workflow moves to 'Launch Product' pipeline -> autoresponder with webinar details & calendar link. tagging @growth-team to review the workflow. olivia: microcopy tweak: change 'fast, reliable inference' to 'predictable, low-latency inference' — more concrete. alex: done. also added SEO phrase 'LLM inference latency optimization' once in para two as Patrick suggested. patrick: all good from tracking. please :thumbsup: if approved before the sync. maya: :thumbsup: sam: :thumbsup: lisa: :thumbsup: olivia: small nit on hero crop, will fix in meeting. :thumbsup: alex: thanks — locking assets after the sync and handing off to eng for deployment.
